data.one_liner: Widgets which create beautiful fluid-like mesh gradients in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable Flutter widgets to render fluid, acrylic-like mesh gradients and animated mesh gradients. Supports manual animation control through controllers, custom points, and various options like blend strength and noise intensity.
use_when: You want to create dynamic, fluid mesh gradient backgrounds in your app.
You need acrylic-like gradients with smooth animations between specific color points.
avoid_when: You only need simple linear or radial gradients supported out-of-the-box by Flutter.
You are targeting environments that do not support shaders properly.
strengths: High degree of customization for gradient points and animation sequences.
Performant implementation utilizing fragment shaders and CustomPainter.
Provides both fully customizable static mesh gradients and easy-to-use animated mesh gradients.
weaknesses: Relies on shaders which may have platform-specific compatibility or runtime error concerns.
Limited to specific use cases involving mesh and fluid background aesthetics.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedMeshGradient(
  colors: [
    Colors.red,
    Colors.blue,
    Colors.green,
    Colors.yellow,
  ],
  options: AnimatedMeshGradientOptions(),
)
